comment: All ten acoustic one-shot modules share one implementation, src/one_shot_base.hh, and differ only in which sixteen samples they hold. The Sample, Pitch and Decay jacks carry no printing on the panel; the manual's opening section says every unlabelled jack is the CV input for the parameter beside it. Decay is scaled against the length of the sample that was selected at the trigger, so the same knob position gives a different time on a long sample and a short one. The samples are stored at 44.1kHz and the playback position is rate-converted against the engine sample rate, so the pitch does not move with the engine rate.
